response: Introducing Saved Views, available today for all customers on paid plans. Saved Views let you capture your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping for any list, so you can return to exactly the setup you need without rebuilding it every time. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every project, sprint, or workflow you juggle. Need a view your teammates rely on too? Views can be shared with a team, so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of recreating it separately. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, tagging priorities, or organizing a sprint board, Saved Views keeps your favorite setups within reach. This update is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, giving your whole team faster access to the information that matters most. We built this feature based on your feedback about repetitive setup work, and we hope it saves you time every day. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
